scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:electron && npm run build:tools && npm run build:renderer
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run clean:test && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test dist-test/src/main/*.test.js dist-test/src/main/providers/*.test.js dist-test/src/shared/*.test.js dist-test/src/renderer/*.test.js
scripts.package:win: npm run icons:verify && npm run build && electron-packager . AIUsageMonitor --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --out=out --overwrite --prune=true --asar --extra-resource=dist-tools --icon=assets/icons/app.ico --ignore="^/(src|scripts|docs|fixtures|dist-test|dist-tools|\.spike|out|tsconfig(?:\..+)?\.json|vite\.config\.ts)(/|$)"
